note: Skin-colour tracks per shot. boxes[k] is frame f0+k: [x0, y0, x1, y1] as fractions of frame width/height, or null where the blob was lost. The box is the visible skin, not the whole head (hair is outside it). Head tracks also carry mouth[k]: how open the drawn mouth is on that frame (0 = closed; share of the lower head box showing mouth interior), read from the picture, so it follows the source's own lip timing.
